statement: Custom silicon from Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI reportedly consumes roughly two-thirds of all AI compute.
why: Hyperscaler ASICs taking the majority of AI compute pressures merchant-GPU share of the workload.

impact.mechanism: Rising custom-silicon share raises hyperscaler-ASIC demand while eroding merchant-GPU share of AI compute.

evidence.excerpt: Custom silicon from Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, and OpenAI now reportedly consumes roughly two-thirds of all AI compute

confidence.basis: Single secondary article using approximate 'roughly two-thirds' framing.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend flat -> rising); sources: TechTimes / Network World
